column1: # Game profile of No Man's Sky (Switch, base game v5308416 = 7.10.0). From a .nup package read in place.
# Hello Games' own engine, SDK 20.5.17, Havok, Wwise, NVN. Modules main and sdk; rtld is replaced by the host.
# RomFS: 99 NMSARC*.pak archives (3.71 GB); the shaders are .nvb records in NMSARC.Shaders.pak.
# Closest reference: 01008BC024FDE000 (STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT, SDK 20.5.17 and the same sdk build).
# The address-space keys are the survey's guesses; mem_used was measured on a phone boot.
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false.
# The survey's 4 GB / 256 MB layout, as the other games without virtual address memory; not measured yet.
# The rewritten modules take 0x5c00000 (92 MB), more than the default 64 MB of used memory. The game sizes its heap as
# pool − used, so SetHeapSize(pool − 64 MB) failed at boot with Result 0x1003 and nn::diag aborted in nninitStartup
# (main+0x2614c58). As in Catherine: Full Body, report 96 MB used; the heap request then fits beside the modules.
# The whole RomFS is NMSARC*.pak; the compiled shaders are expected in NMSARC.Shaders.pak.
